items.definition:
a feeling of intense excitement and happiness
She felt a sense of euphoria after winning the competition.

the emission of light by a substance that has absorbed light or other electromagnetic radiation
The mineral exhibited a strong fluorescence under UV light.

a unit in the Indian numbering system equal to one hundred thousand (100,000)
The project cost several lakh rupees.

Wild party
The ancient festival was said to involve an orgy.

Abundance
The internet offers a plethora of information.

A radioactive element
Plutonium is a highly radioactive element.

Severe mental disorder
Symptoms of psychosis include hallucinations and delusions.

ghost, haunting presence
The spectre of unemployment loomed over the country.

a chemical element that is a poisonous metalloid.
Arsenic is a highly toxic substance.

a league or alliance
The small states formed a confederacy for mutual defense.

a severe test or trial
The new policy was put to the crucible of public opinion.

permanent software programmed into a read-only memory
You might need to update the firmware on your router.

the process or state of breaking into small or separate parts
Disk fragmentation can slow down your computer.

the quality of being clever, original, and inventive
Her ingenuity allowed her to solve the complex problem.

a person who tries to influence legislation
A powerful lobbyist was trying to influence the new law.

cloud of gas and dust in space
The Orion Nebula is a well-known star-forming region.

study of the nervous system
She decided to specialize in neurology after medical school.

tree with its top branches cut back
The old oak tree had been pollarded many times.

person who supervises an exam
The proctor walked around the room during the test.

original or first form
Scientists are studying the proto-star to understand its formation.

a person who deserts a cause or group
He was considered a renegade by his former colleagues.

the division of something into smaller parts
Market segmentation helps companies target specific customer groups.

the act of transplanting (e.g., an organ or plant)
Organ transplantation has saved many lives.

a group of three
The company is run by a triad of executives.

great courage, especially in battle
The soldier was awarded a medal for his valor in combat.

the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region
The poem was written in the local vernacular.

complete destruction or obliteration
The asteroid caused the annihilation of the dinosaurs.

protection or support; patronage
The project was conducted under the auspices of the university.

an event causing great and often sudden damage or distress; a disaster
The flood was a great calamity for the small town.

fighter, participant in combat
Both combatants were exhausted after the long fight.

heat transfer by fluid movement
Heat is transferred through convection in the oven.

cybernetic organism
The movie featured a powerful cyborg.

the act of turning aside
The deflection of the light beam was noticeable.

the act of making more diverse
The company pursued diversification into new markets.

the process of passing a law
The enactment of the new law will have a significant impact.

waste matter from the bowels
The laboratory analyzed the animal's feces.

the realization or fulfillment of a plan or project
His plans finally came to fruition.

impressiveness, especially of appearance or style
The palace retained its former grandeur.

anger
The politician's comments drew the ire of the public.

a person who is honored for achieving distinction in a particular field or with a particular award
She is a Nobel laureate in literature.

a confused fight or scuffle
The protest turned into a violent melee.

a chemical group derived from methane
Methyl alcohol is also known as methanol.

a group of highly regarded people or a temple dedicated to all gods
He joined the pantheon of great American writers.

a document describing a school, business, or investment
The university sent out a detailed prospectus to all applicants.

the action of enticing someone into sexual activity or a course of action
The advertisement used subtle techniques of seduction to attract customers.

a durable twilled fabric
The uniform was made of a sturdy serge fabric.

the quality of being specific
The report lacked specificity in its recommendations.

the careful and responsible management of something entrusted to one's care
Environmental stewardship is crucial for our planet.

the interaction or cooperation of two or more organizations, substances, or other agents to produce a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects
The merger created a synergy that boosted both companies' profits.

the quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable
The absurdity of the situation made everyone laugh.

a medieval chemical science and speculative philosophy aiming to transmute base metals into gold
Ancient alchemists sought to turn lead into gold.

things associated with the culture of the United States
The museum displayed a collection of Americana.

a substance that causes the immune system to produce antibodies
The vaccine introduces a weakened antigen to stimulate immunity.

a bitter greenish-brown fluid that aids digestion
The liver produces bile, which helps break down fats.

the rule or reign of a caliph or chief Muslim ruler
The Ottoman Empire was the last major caliphate.

the action or practice of circumcising
Circumcision is a religious or medical practice in some cultures.

a sudden and ignominious failure; a fiasco
The entire project was a complete debacle from start to finish.

fame or superiority, especially in a profession or sphere
His eminence in the field of physics is widely recognized.

a mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument
It's a common fallacy that money brings happiness.

a judicial inquiry to ascertain the facts relating to an incident
The coroner held an inquest into the cause of death.

a sharp twist or bend; a peculiarity of character or behavior
There was a kink in the hose, stopping the water flow.

a small, wingless parasitic insect; a contemptible person
The gardener found a louse on the rose bush.

a person who advocates or practices modernism, especially in art, literature, or architecture
He was a leading modernist architect of his time.

secret or dishonest activity or maneuvering; mischief
The children were always up to some kind of shenanigan.
